note: The dialogs an NPC says when a player talks to it (crates/asura-world/src/dialog.rs, docs/55-npc-dialogs.md). A dialog is found by map and by the placement's literal name in maps/.../npcs.json, exactly as vendors.json finds a merchant. The body and every label are the encoded string units the live server sent, not text: the client resolves them through its own string table.

fields.dialogs: One per NPC on one map. The first page is what a talk opens.
fields.talk_range: Optional. How near, in map units, a player must come for a talk to be answered, when the NPC stands where the player cannot walk up to it (Sir Tydus's stand). Absent means the movement file's interact_range. Chosen, not measured.
fields.pages: The body (0x0080 units) and the choices (0x007E) under it.
fields.buttons: icon, the encoded label units, the id the client sends back in 0x803B, the skill field (4294967295 when it names none), and the action.
fields.action: close answers nothing; window opens 0x0083 with that kind; merchant opens the NPC's window through vendors.json; page shows another page; quest with step offer, reward or credit accepts the quest, takes its turn-in or completes its talk objective, then shows `page` or the first page that offers or rewards a quest; unanswered is a choice the capture never exercised and is only logged.
fields.generated: True for an entry tools/npc-content-from-captures.py writes; the tool replaces those and keeps the rest.
fields.when: A page's or a choice's condition: quest_offer_open, quest_reward_open, quest_active (accepted, objective not done), or answer (a page only a choice opens). Absent is always.
